# 48 Wall Street NYC — Historic Event Venue

> 48 Wall Street is a premier historic event venue located in Manhattan's Financial District, New York City. Housed in the landmark 1927 Bank of New York & Trust Company building (listed on the National Register of Historic Places), the venue offers 12,500 sq ft of grand event space with 30-foot soaring ceilings, a grand marble staircase, Palladian windows, and original 1920s architecture. Maximum capacity: 500 guests for cocktail receptions, 350 for seated dinners.

## Contact & Location

- **Address:** 48 Wall Street, Lobby 1, New York, NY 10005
- **Phone:** 212.971.5353
- **Email:** info@48WallNYC.com
- **Website:** https://www.48wallnyc.com
- **Neighborhood:** Financial District, Lower Manhattan
- **Nearest Transit:** Wall Street (2/3), Broad Street (J/Z), Rector Street (1)

## Event Types Hosted

- **Corporate Events** — Conferences, meetings, product launches, company town halls, team building, sales kickoffs, executive gatherings
- **Conferences** — Multi-day conferences, breakout sessions, keynote presentations with full AV support
- **Holiday Events** — Corporate holiday parties, end-of-year galas, office Christmas parties, seasonal celebrations
- **Non-Profit Events** — Charity galas, fundraising dinners, benefit events, award ceremonies, foundation events
- **Bar & Bat Mitzvahs** — Full-service Bar and Bat Mitzvah celebrations with catering and production
- **Weddings** — Ceremonies and receptions for 50-500 guests; historic backdrop with grand marble staircase
- **Fashion Shows** — Runway events, New York Fashion Week presentations, designer showcases, trunk shows, brand launches
- **Film & Photo Shoots** — Commercial shoots, TV productions, film location rentals, period-piece backdrops, holding space

## Venue Spaces

### Grand Mezzanine Banking Hall
- 9,000 sq ft
- 30-foot ceilings with original crystal chandeliers
- Grand marble staircase
- Palladian windows
- Seats 350 / Reception 500

### Concourse Level
- 3,500 sq ft
- Breakout rooms available
- Ideal for smaller meetings, seminars, cocktail hours

## Services

### Catering — Tardi's Catering
- Partner: Tardi's Catering (founded 1994, 30+ years experience)
- Seated dinners, cocktail receptions, buffets, breakfast, lunch, specialty stations
- Kosher, halal, vegan, gluten-free, and allergen-specific accommodations available

### Event Production — MMEink Worldwide
- Full AV: sound, microphones, projection, screens
- Professional lighting design: uplighting, pin spotting, gobo projections
- Custom staging and runway stages
- Entertainment coordination: DJs, live music, performers
- Custom fabrication: signage, installations, backdrops

### Event Rentals
- Furniture, decor, specialty items, equipment rentals through partner vendors

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does it cost to rent 48 Wall Street?**
Pricing depends on event type, date, guest count, and services required. Contact us at 212.971.5353 or info@48WallNYC.com for a custom quote.

**What is the capacity at 48 Wall Street?**
Up to 500 guests for cocktail receptions and up to 350 guests for seated dinners.

**Does 48 Wall Street provide catering?**
Yes. Through our exclusive partner Tardi's Catering, we offer full-service catering for all event types including seated dinners, cocktail receptions, and buffets.

**Can I host a wedding at 48 Wall Street?**
Yes. 48 Wall Street hosts wedding ceremonies and receptions for 50–500 guests. The grand marble staircase and 30-foot ceilings provide a timeless historic backdrop.

**Where is 48 Wall Street located?**
48 Wall Street, Lobby 1, New York, NY 10005 — in the Financial District of Lower Manhattan, steps from Wall Street subway stations.

**Is 48 Wall Street available for corporate events?**
Yes. We specialize in corporate events including conferences, product launches, company galas, meetings, and holiday parties. State-of-the-art AV and breakout rooms available.

**Does 48 Wall Street host non-profit fundraisers?**
Yes. We welcome charity galas, fundraising dinners, benefit events, and nonprofit celebrations. Contact us to discuss pricing options for non-profit organizations.
